notes.title: Is the soundtrack downloaded?
notes.content:
Among those who purchased the DLC soundtrack,
Is there anyone who can not install properly?

If the DLC soundtrack is not installed,
It may be resolved by logging out of Steam and restarting it.
By default it is stored in the following directory.
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Moe Mekuri SP - 萌めくりSP -
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28530896/a021687f722687df604911830bd80d905bc1b134.jpg[/img]


In Steam, downloading starts by checking the check box in the DLC list.
If the DLC list is not displayed, it will be displayed when starting up the game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28530896/a87e7baf1eaafa7ffcd337a1d8a8508e7dd621dd.jpg[/img]


When the download is completed, open the MUSIC library and scan the soundtrack.
Check the box ① to search Steam folder.
② Click to scan.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28530896/85bc481436badc31ff1b6325a0ce4016c67ecdc5.jpg[/img]


When scanning is successful, a DLC sound track is added to the MUSIC library.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28530896/095c68610929d1118e0e7264edbcc31aa7084a16.jpg[/img]


If it is not added in this way, I do not understand.
Steam personal setting and PC setting may be a problem.
